families.signature: Soft-target scavenger: engaged rats go for whoever has the lowest Defense, not whoever stands closest.
Wounded scuttler: below half HP it turns on the furthest party member, past the front line.
Hunter of strength: goes for your hardest hitter.
Challenge the healthiest: pressures whoever has the most HP.
Spread the engagement: goes for whoever has the fewest attackers.
Wounded-target pressure: attacks and spells go for whoever has the least HP.
Peck afflicted prey: prefers a party member already showing a bad status.
Hunt the warded target: prefers a party member showing a good status.
Facing sentinel: prefers whoever is looking at it.
Withdraw and ward: below half HP it wards itself once.
Committed giant: below half HP it Rams, then stands exposed.
One recovery: below half HP it uses Restore once, then fights on.
One draining recovery: below half HP, one Leech 2.
Comet commitment: below half HP, one Choco-Comet, then a pause.
One rebound ward: below half HP it wards itself once.
Readable fuse: below half HP it wards itself and pauses, before its native blast.
Breath escalation: below half HP, one Bad Breath, then a pause.
Recovery window: runs low, stops to recover once, and is open while it does.
Pass and recover: below half HP it strikes, breaks away, then returns.
Warned sweep: below half HP, Ram, then its tail or a heavy blow, then a pause.
Ram and fang: below half HP, Ram, then Sonic Fangs, then a pause.
Afflicted backbite: a bad status provokes one Gnaw, then a pause. The ailment still works.
Last hunter: alone in its group, it commits to two attacks, then pauses.
Caster suppression: goes after an active caster, with one Silence where it has the spell.
Ranged opening: one Bile, Fireball or Curse at range, then it closes in.
Chorus: a grouped toad sings Angelsong once.
War song: a grouped member sings Warsong once.
Flock warder: wards another of its flock once.
Guard the group: wards another of its group once.
Backline leap: one Jump at the furthest party member.
Home-water volley: near its spawn it fires water at range; away from home it fights normally.
